steps.en: Download the build for your OS from a GitHub release and install it
steps.zh: 从 GitHub release 下载对应系统的安装包并装上

steps.en: Open a PDF and pick a tool: Organize pages, Combine files, a comment or a form field
steps.zh: 打开 PDF，选一个工具：整理页面、合并文件、加批注或填表单

steps.en: Parses and repairs the file, decrypts it if protected, and renders pages in tiles
steps.zh: 解析并修复文件，受保护的先解密，再分块渲染页面

component.zh: cos 解析器 + hayro 渲染器

steps.en: Keeps every edit as an undoable step in memory, autosaving every minute
steps.zh: 每次修改都作为可撤销的一步留在内存里，每分钟自动保存

steps.en: Appends an incremental update atomically; original bytes and encryption stay as they were
steps.zh: 以原子写入追加一次增量更新，原有字节和加密方式保持不变

value.en: Acrobat-style organize, comment, fill and protect on your own machine, with no account, subscription or upload
value.zh: 在自己电脑上完成 Acrobat 式的整理、批注、填表和加密，不用账号、不用订阅、不用上传

sources: https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft#downloads (release file names for Windows MSI, macOS DMG, Linux AppImage)
https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft#organize-pages-like-cards-on-a-table (Organize pages, undo, incremental + atomic saves, autosave every minute)
